chunks: And from him, from his father, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'I will be an intercessor on the Day of Judgement for four types of people, and even though they may have come with the sins of the people of the world – a man who helped my children; and a man who spent his wealth for my descendants during constraints; and a man who loved my children by the tongue and by the heart; and a man who strived regarding the needs of my children when they were either expelled or displaced.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the four types of people for whom the Prophet will intercede on the Day of Judgement?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the Shia doctrine of intercession (Shafa'ah) specifically tied to love and service for the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that material and emotional support for the Prophet's progeny holds immense spiritual weight. It underscores the practical obligation of caring for the descendants of Hashim, linking their social welfare directly to the believer's ultimate salvation and the Prophet's intercessory power on the Day of Resurrection.

en.hubeali:
And from him, from his father, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> would be an intercessor on the Day of Judgement for four types (of people) and even though they may have come with the sins of the people of the world – a man who helped my<sup>saww</sup> children; and a man who spent his wealth for my<sup>saww</sup> descendants during constraints; and a man who loved my<sup>saww</sup> children by the tongue, and by the heart; and a man who strived regarding the needs of my<sup>saww</sup> children when they were either expelled or displaced’.
en.sarwar: 9. It is narrated from him (narrator of previous Hadith) from his father from certain individuals of our people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has narrated this Hadith.

‘The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, “On the Day of Judgment I will intercede on behalf of four kinds of people, even though they may come with the sins of the people of the world. Of such people is a man who has supported my children, one who has spent his property for my children in difficult times, a man who loves my children by his tongue and heart, and a man who strives hard to meet the needs of my children when they are driven away or expelled.’””
